title: Document management
goal: Model document-owned pages and versions alongside retained folders and access grants.

rubric.must: Document has filled composition diamonds to Page and Version, each with 1..* multiplicity.
Folder has a hollow aggregation diamond to Document rather than a filled composition diamond.
AccessGrant has directed associations to both Permission and Document.
SearchIndex has a dashed dependency arrow to Document.
Permission is visibly an enumeration with READ, WRITE, and ADMIN literals.
